Indian Cities Issue Weather and Air Quality Forecasts

Several Indian cities have released weather forecasts for the day, with some also providing Air Quality Index (AQI) levels. These reports offer local residents information on expected weather conditions and air pollution levels. The forecasts cover various regions across the country, aiming to inform the public about daily environmental conditions.
